1.description: [Elune] [Blood and Guts] - Increased the base damage and scaling of Executing Disembowel by 30%.

[Elune] [Vanguard of Hellscream] - Vanguard of Hellscream now has a 50% change to trigger, buffed from 35%.
[Elune] [Static Shock] - Static Shock now has a 1 second internal cooldown, buffed from 1.5.
[Elune] [Elemental Fusion] - Elemental Fusion now increases the damage of Lava Sweep and Lightning Blade by 15% per stack, buffed from 10%.
[Elune] [Searing Rage] - Searing Rage now increases the damage of Lava Sweep by 25%, buffed from 15%.
[Elune] [Super Hot] - Super Hot now increases the damage of Lava Sweep by 10%, buffed from 6%.
[Elune] [Stormborn] - Doubled the damage of Stormborn against monsters.
[Elune] [Stormforged Edge] - Stormforged Edge now stacks up to 8, changed from 12.
[Elune] [Stormforged Edge] - Stormforged Edge now increases the damage of next Stormstrike by 24%, buffed from 12%.
[Elune] [Critical Cycles] - Eclipse (Lunar) now increases the damage of Moonfire by 70%. Up from 50%.
[Elune] [Total Lunar Eclipse] - Eclipse (Lunar) now increases the Arcane damage dealt by 25%, buffed from 15%.
[Elune] [Molten Earth] - Tripled the attack power scaling of Molten Earth.
[Elune] [Molten Earth] - Doubled base damage and spell power scaling of Molten Earth.
[Elune] [Molten Earth] - Molten Earth now lasts 8 seconds, buffed from 6 seconds.
[Elune] [Sheer Power] - New talent: Critical hits with melee and ranged abilities increase your Strength and Agility by 12%. This does not work if you know Mental Quickness.
[Elune] [Intellectuality of Balanced Mind] - New talent: While your Intellect exceeds your Spirit, critical strikes with spells increase Spell Haste Rating by 7% of your Intellect.
[Elune] [Single-Minded Fury] - No longer decreases the damage of said abilities.
[Elune] [Ray of Frost] now deals 30% reduced damage in PvP combat.
[Elune] [Ray of Frost] - Increased the base damage and scaling of Ray of Frost by 15%.
[Elune] [Phalanx Strike] - Phalanx Strike now increases the damage of Thrust by 38% stack, buffed from 30%.
[Elune] [Cremation] - Now deals its damage every 2 seconds over 10 seconds, buffed from every 3 seconds over 21 seconds.
[Elune] [Cremation] - Cremation now deals 7 times the total periodic damage of consumed periodic effects, buffed from 5 times the amount.
[Elune] [Widowmaker] - Now has a 33% chance to proc and 5 second internal cooldown, buffed from 18% and 7 second cooldown.
[Elune] [Natural Selection] - Natural Selection can now trigger up to 15 times before going on 15 second cooldown.
[Elune] [Druidic Overload] - Druidic Overload now also doubles the chance to trigger Lightninig Mastery talent.
[Elune] [Endless Agonizer] - You can now extend Curse of Agony by 24 additional seconds. Recasting Curse of Agony resets the counter.
[Elune] [Endless Agonizer] - Now extends the duration of Curse of Agony by 1 second, buffed from 0.6 seconds.
[Elune] [Exploding Storm] - Exploding Storm now increases the damage of Explosive Trap by 50% per stack, buffed from 40%.
[Elune] [Exploding Storm] - Exploding Storm now increases the damage of Immolation Trap by 85% per stack, buffed from 70%.
[Elune] [Compound Speed] - Compound Speed now increases your ranged attack speed by 30%, buffed from 20%.
[Elune] [Pack Alpha] - Pack Alpha now increases your haste by 25%, buffed from 20%.
[Elune] [Arcane Divinity] - Increased the base damage and scaling of Arcane Barrage (Divine) by 35%.
[Elune] [Arcane Divinity] - Increased the base damage and scaling of Arcane Blast (Divine) by 35%.

7.description: [Pending Restart] [Elune] [Battle Fury] - Corrected the tooltip to properly mention Warrior abilities, the Physical ability requirement has also been removed. It has always just been Warrior abilities, this is just a tooltip update.

[Pending Restart] [Area-52] [Corrupted Shiv] - No longer increases the damage of your next Shadow spell or ability by 20% after using Shiv. It now increases your Shadow damage by 10% for 4 seconds after using Shiv.

[Pending Restart] [Area-52] [Seething Flames] - Fixed an issue with Seething Flames where Chimeric Fire could be activated regardless of your current stacks. As compensation, the required stacks and total stacks on Chimeric Fire have now been lowered from 5 to 4, and now increases the damage of Chimera Shot by 25% per stack up from 20% per stack.

[Pending Restart] [Area-52] [Unrelenting Wrath] - Fixed a bug causing Unrelenting Wrath to remove current Unrelenting Assault stacks.

[Pending Restart] [Area-52] [Compound Power] - Compound Flurry is now triggered from just using Aimed Shot, Multi-Shot, Arcane Shot or Chimera Shot. It no longer requires Improved Steady Shot to be consumed to gain the effect.

[Pending Restart] [Area-52] [Spot Weakness] - No longer teaches you Kill Shot - Spot Weakness. The Spot Weakness proc now reduces the global cooldown of regular Kill Shot and allows casting it regardless of your targets current health threshold. Additionally, it now increases damage dealt with Kill Shot by 30% to targets below 35% health.
